summary: One built-in-tool sample is recorded for illustration. It is not GPT Image 2 API promotion evidence.

notes: The square tile has an original hand-cut-paper look, deep ink-blue ground, moth and fern hierarchy, open spacing, and no visible text or branding.

A temporary 3-by-3 repeat inspection showed continuous-looking edge joins without an obvious hard seam, but the six complete interior moths plus cropped edge continuations make exact source-tile motif counting ambiguous.
The output is 1254x1254 rather than the prompt's 1024x1024 target; exact model, model version, seed, request parameters, and request ID were not exposed.
